besuchen.es: ir a ver a alguien, visitar

texto: Although the present is used much for daily plans, the formal future time (* Futur I *) is formed with the **werden** auxiliary:
**ich werde, du wirst, er/sie/es wird, wir werden, ihr werdet, sie/Sie werden**.
The auxiliary * werden * occupies the **segunda posición** and the main verb in infinitive is located at the **final absoluto** of prayer:
**Morgen werde ich meine Freunde besuchen.** (I will visit my friends tomorrow).
**Im Sommer werden wir nach Berlin reisen.** (In summer we will travel to Berlin).
**Was wirst du am Wochenende machen?** (What will you do for the weekend?).
**Wirst du morgen Zeit haben?** (Will you have time tomorrow?).

bloques.titulo: Conjugation of the «werden» Auxiliary in future
filas: Will you come or will you come?

frases.de: Was wirst du am Wochenende machen, Tim?
frases.es: ¿Qué harás el fin de semana, Tim?
frases.en: What are you doing this weekend, Tim?

frases.de: Am Samstag werde ich meine Freunde besuchen. Und du?
frases.es: El sábado visitaré a mis amigos. ¿Y tú?
frases.en: I'll visit my friends on Saturday. And you?

frases.de: Ich werde am Sonntag mit dem Fahrrad nach Hamburg reisen.
frases.es: El domingo viajaré en bicicleta a Hamburgo.
frases.en: On Sunday, I'll ride a bike to Hamburg.

frases.de: Das ist super! Werdet ihr am Abend zusammen kochen?
frases.es: ¡Eso es genial! ¿Cocinaréis por la noche juntos?
frases.en: That's great! Will you cook at night together?

frases.de: Ja, das werden wir bestimmt machen!
Im Sommer werden wir nach Spanien reisen.
frases.en: In summer we will travel to Spain.

frases.de: Morgen wird Thomas ein neues Auto kaufen.
frases.es: Mañana Thomas comprará un coche nuevo.
frases.en: Tomorrow Thomas will buy a new car.

frases.de: Was werdet ihr am Sonntag machen?
frases.en: What will you do on Sunday?

bloques.pregunta: How do you structure a future prayer with «werden» in German?

opciones.texto: The werden auxiliary conjugated in position 2 and the main verb in infinitive at the end.
opciones.explicacion: The temporary clamp requires «werden» to conjugate and the infinitive close the prayer.

opciones.texto: El auxiliar werden seguido inmediatamente por el verbo principal conjugado.
opciones.explicacion: Two conjugated verbs in a row is a grammatical in German prayer.

opciones.texto: The infinitive of the main verb in position 2 and wert at the end.
opciones.explicacion: The element that is conjugated and occupied the second position is the «werden» auxiliary.

bloques.pregunta: You want to ask a friend «What are you doing tomorrow?». What's the right way?

opciones.explicacion: 2nd person singular «wirst du» with «machen» infinitive at the end.
«Wird» corresponds to the 3rd person singular («er / sie / es»).
The verb of action must remain infinitive without conjugating.

bloques.pregunta: In the «Morgen werde ich meine Freunde besuchen» phrase, why does «besuchen» go to the end?

opciones.texto: Because the times composed of auxiliaries place the infinitive at the end of the sentence.
opciones.explicacion: The syntactic rule of the German verbal clamp moves the infinitive to the closure.

opciones.texto: Because «Freunde» is plural and demands infinitive behind.
opciones.explicacion: The order of the sentence does not depend on the number of the direct complement.

opciones.texto: Because «morgen» can only be accompanied by verbs at the end.
opciones.explicacion: The «morgen» warning does not impose the infinitive.

bloques.frase: Im Sommer ___ wir nach Spanien reisen. (viajaremos)

opciones.explicacion: Plural form of 1st person of the «werden» auxiliary: «wir werden».

bloques.frase: Thomas wird morgen ein neues Auto kaufen.

opciones.texto: Thomas will buy a new car tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: «Wird ... kaufen» forms the future time of the action with the «werden» auxiliary.

opciones.texto: Thomas bought a used car yesterday.
opciones.explicacion: Yesterday it would be «gestern» and the verb describes a future action.

opciones.texto: Thomas wants to rent a car today.

bloques.frase: Wir werden im Sommer nach Spanien reisen
bloques.traduccion: In summer we will travel to Spain
bloques.explicacion: Subject + werden + im Sommer + destination + infinitive.

intro: Learn to form future time (Futur I) by using the auxiliary werden verb combined with an infinitive at the end to express projects and predictions with complete correction.
